verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page says 2FA protects code so that only authorized users can access it, which confirms first-party two-factor authentication. The evidence never says which second factor is used, so TOTP authenticator-app support is implied but not shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation of TOTP authenticator-app enrollment, per-user account setup steps for developers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
